data.title: Route Overview
paragraphs: The Coromandel Coast holds several very different cultural worlds within a manageable road journey. Chennai provides the urban frame, Kanchipuram introduces sacred architecture and silk, Mamallapuram shifts to Pallava stone and sea, and Puducherry changes the street pattern and colonial texture.

The final movement toward Chidambaram returns to Tamil sacred geography before the route closes. The itinerary balances temples with textiles, food, neighbourhood walking, coast, and slower heritage stays so that no single theme overwhelms the journey.

data.title: Suggested Packing & Preparation
items: Breathable, modest clothing for warm weather and temple access.
Comfortable sandals or shoes that are easy to remove.
Sun protection for Mamallapuram’s exposed monument landscape.
A lightweight scarf for sacred sites and air-conditioned interiors.
A compact umbrella for tropical showers and strong sun.

data.quote: The Coromandel Coast is a lesson in adjacency: granite shrine, silk loom, colonial facade, fishing shore, and modern city can sit within one day’s journey.
data.author: THE DESIGNER'S NOTEBOOK

data.title: COASTAL HEAT NOTE
data.text: Most outdoor monument visits are scheduled early or late. Midday is reserved for long lunches, shaded interiors, craft visits, or rest, especially from March through June.

data.title: Stone, Silk & Sea Air
paragraphs: The route’s pleasure comes from contrast. Kanchipuram’s sacred weight, Mamallapuram’s sculpted stone, Puducherry’s street geometry, and Chennai’s urban energy sharpen one another.
You leave with a broader sense of the Coromandel as a cultural coast rather than a collection of separate day trips.

items.question: Can this route be tailored to our preferred dates and pace?
paragraphs: Yes. Every Signature itinerary is a design framework, and we adjust nights, experiences, transport, and daily intensity around your interests and travel dates.

items.question: Is Puducherry the main focus of the route?
paragraphs: No. It is one chapter within a wider Coromandel journey that gives equal weight to Tamil heritage.

items.question: Can we spend more time at the beach?
paragraphs: Yes. Additional coastal nights can be added near Mamallapuram or Puducherry.

items.question: Is Kanchipuram a day trip?
paragraphs: Usually yes on this route, with the day structured around a few important temples and a meaningful weaving visit.

items.question: What is the policy for date changes or cancellations?
paragraphs: We work directly with our partners to move dates whenever possible. Any non-refundable permits, transport tickets, or supplier penalties are passed through transparently.

Less than 30 days before arrival: cancellation follows the confirmed supplier terms in your final proposal.
